skills.short_description: Pull enemies into a damaging control zone.
skills.long_description: Place a singularity that drags enemies backward and groups them for area damage.

skills.short_description: Trap a lane position and rewind enemies.
skills.long_description: Place a mine that displaces the first enemies crossing it and exposes them to follow-up damage.

skills.short_description: Summon allied soldiers to hold the lane.
skills.long_description: Deploy a temporary squad that advances, attacks enemies, and buys time for the tower.
Place a barracks that periodically creates allied soldiers until it expires or is destroyed.

skills.short_description: Weaken enemies inside a marked area.
skills.long_description: Expose armor and resistance so the tower and allied units deal more damage to marked enemies.
Restore allied health and grant soldiers a short damage and speed boost.
Build a small turret that attacks nearby enemies until its lifetime ends.

skills.short_description: Slow enemies and build toward a freeze.
skills.long_description: Cover an area in cold that reduces enemy speed and makes clustered targets easier to control.

skills.short_description: Send drones to hunt or support units.
skills.long_description: Release a temporary swarm that attacks priority enemies and can be specialized toward disruption or defense.
A fixture skill composed from existing effect operations; it exists to prove new authored skills can load, cast, replay, and appear in the HUD without a GameSim switch case.
